title: Wapuu Studio – Design Your Own Wapuu with AI
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…you can now create your own Wapuu with AI.

Just describe your idea, and Wapuu Studio will turn it into a unique character. Whether it's a wizard, an astronaut, or a coffee-loving developer with headphones, it's up to you.

You can save your creations, browse Wapuus made by the community, and visit the Wapuu Museum to explore classic and official designs. Try it at wapuu.studio.
